newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Copper and aluminium seen under pressure.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Copper and aluminium seen under pressure.

text.p: 3 MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Copper and aluminium prices are expected to come under pressure following poor chart closes on Wednesday, traders and chartists said.
Copper may test support at $2,250, while aluminium could retrace towards $1,650, they added.
COPPER - Wednesday's breach of $2,300 a tonne has left the market open to falls towards initial support of $2,275 and possibly $2,250, traders and analysts said on Thursday.
London Metal Exchange (LME) stocks are expected to show another rise which could add to the downside pressure.
"With stocks also continuing to increase the outlook in the short term does not look good and we feel the market can only continue to come under pressure," an analyst said.
"Closed poorly on the charts and appears headed lower as the moving averages continue to fall," LME brokers Brandeis said. Brandeis pegged support levels at $2,285, $2,250 and $2,226.
Harry Creates of Amalgamated Metal Trading (AMT) said the poor close on Wednesday could signal a test of support at $2,270 and $2,245.
On the upside $2,300 is likely to offer first resistance.
Creates said there is resistance up to $2,366 to overcome before trendline resistance at $2,410 can be challenged.
At 0710 GMT three months LME copper was quoted at $2,283/88, unchanged from Wednesday's late London close.

ALUMINIUM - Expected to come under downside pressure following its move below $1,700 on Wednesday. "Closed below the key support level, which is disappointing and could provoke further losses on Thursday," Brandeis said.
They pegged support at $1,675, followed by $1,650.

"Aluminium is looking a little over-cooked and in need of a period of consolidation, if not a corrective pull back, as the overbought technical indicators begin to turn off the highs," Martin Squires of Rudolf Wolff said.
Resistance was pegged at $1,700, and $1,725.
At 0710 GMT three months aluminium was quoted at $1,682/85, against $1,687/90.
